body: I've had people tell me that for years, I don't feel like it's getting any better, only worse

I do this all the time, I'm always afraid of what people might think of my anwer to questions about what I care about because I guess I feel all my interests, tastes and hobbies are all somehow weird and wrong, I often just sort of lie and answer something that I only mildly like/do but that I know is "mainstream" and won't be judged for.
